about_the_game:
Welcome to Washington! High Voltage tasks you with building a hydropower plant across 3 large maps with the help of 3 new trucks. Repair Washington’s infrastructure to deliver the super-sized equipment needed at the dam, patch up the region’s small towns to welcome new workers and more!

• Three new 4km² maps set in Washington. Take on new challenges in the lush forests and hilly terrain of the northwestern USA.

• Three new vehicles: the H.I.B Billert 1980, an Off-road truck with excellent suspensions and a wide range of available add-ons, the PLAD 440 “Buddy”, a nimble Off-road truck with switchable AWD and differential lock capabilities and the Sleiter ST833 “Chimera”, a formidably durable workhorse with superior torque and great ground clearance.

• New activities: Repair and modernize Washington’s infrastructure following a streak of extreme weather events to assist in the construction of the state’s newest hydropower plant. Rebuild river crossings and tunnels, patch up local small towns to house new workers and prop local industries back up to operation before delivering a super-sized turbine to the dam.

Season 16 is SnowRunner’s fourth expansion and is included in the Year 4 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.
